fix.RC2-mechanism: Credential classification for ENTRY (TYPE/TAP-into-field) now requires the ACTION'S OWN TARGET to be the credential field: H8/H3-entry targetIsSecret = !browserChrome && (targetField.isPassword || secret wording on the candidate's own id/label); H4 entry requires targetField membership with identifier wording on the field's NAME (id+label — value dropped) or targetField.isPassword, over the unchanged form-level pair. The omnibox/URL-bar is excluded STRUCTURALLY: the service marks the com.android.chrome:id/url_bar subtree browserChrome during the walk; the flag rides ObservedNode -> Candidate (additive defaults, fixtures decode false); FieldDescriptor.fromNodes drops browserChrome editables from form context and RiskGate's targetIsSecret cannot fire on a browser-chrome candidate (its label IS the page URL — the wording fallback would otherwise re-open the leak on password-named pages). The SUBMIT arms keep their form-level law: a submit over an identifier+secret pair still gates H4, a lone flagged secret still gates H3. Chosen mechanism documented: structural (the observation CAN distinguish browser UI by viewId — the exact id UrlBarReader already reads) because pure target-scoping provably does not close the live case.
fix.RC1-mechanism: enterText's cause-reporting overload (default delegates to the 3-arg, every existing JVM fake compiles unchanged) reports the terminal failure cause — WRONG_WINDOW / NO_FIELD_AT_POINT / REFRESH_FAILED / SET_TEXT_REJECTED / PASTE_FAILED / CLIPBOARD_UNAVAILABLE (progressive; the loop logs the LAST reported on the execute line as '-> FAILED (CAUSE)', plain '-> FAILED' byte-identical without one). GestureExecutor first waits BOUNDED (~5s budget, 400ms cadence, executor-internal constants) for the ACTIVE window's package to be an allowlisted browser — the pure decision textEntryWindowCause beside BrowserPackages is JVM-pinned, the Android wrapper thin. The restore readiness bar is fixed at the loop: readiness = usable tree AND StepObservation.windowPackage (the ACTIVE window's package, threaded LoopObservation -> HarnessObserver -> StepObservation additive default '') in the browser allowlist; ready/timeout log lines name the validated/last-seen package. After a successful paste the clipboard is cleared (the secret lingered there).

deviations: Structural browser-chrome exclusion chosen over target-scoping-alone (the dispatch's own alternative): target-scoping alone does NOT close the live case because the omnibox's identifier wording rides its a11y LABEL (the page URL text), not a value — the live RCA's 'login' in 'login.html' was the label. The observation can distinguish browser UI cheaply by viewId (the exact id UrlBarReader reads), so the flag rides NodeSnapshot -> ObservedNode -> Candidate (all additive defaults; no committed fixture edited; the Phase-2 node-shape precedent is the isPassword addition).

browserChrome detection covers Chrome stable's url_bar viewId only (the live-proven surface); the webview shell's chrome is not marked — the shell is a test browser and its bar was never the defect surface.

The secret-binding check is wired in the loop (bind at ApproveWithSecret, verify at execute) and pinned through the loop's own requireSecretCandidateBinding helper, because the loop's single-pass wiring cannot naturally diverge the bound and acting candidates — the helper pins both directions loud (the wrong-TextSource precedent).

Wording tension noted, not edited: vision 06 §1 H4 'identifier+secret pair typing' and H8 'credential typing into any field' read page-scoped; the fix implements the owner-ratified target-scoped reading (a page HAVING a secret never credential-classifies other fields) and keeps the SUBMIT arms form-level per the dispatch. No vision text changed.
The execute line's plain '-> FAILED' shape is preserved byte-identical when the executor reports no cause (pre-RC1 fakes), per the existing CredentialEntryLoopTest pin.
